project_info.theme: Multi-combo catalog poster for hair and body care bundles
project_info.color_palette: Clean White, Pomelo Green, Berry Pink, Amber Gold, Plum

main_subject.detail: A clean white catalog-style poster presenting multiple Cocoon combo bundles with product pairs, pink price circles, and 'GIẢM 36%' badges, including pomelo shampoo refill, sugar shower gel, pomelo shampoo, pomelo hair tonic, and Gleditsia scalp scrub.
main_subject.style: Retail catalog poster, minimal e-commerce layout, realistic packshot arrangement

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes combo descriptions such as 'COMBO Túi Refill Dầu Gội Bưởi Không Sulfate 500ml Gel Tắm Đường Thốt Nốt An Giang 500ml', 'COMBO Dầu Gội Bưởi Không Sulfate 310ml Nước Dưỡng Tóc Tinh Dầu Bưởi 140ml', 'COMBO Dầu Gội Bưởi Không Sulfate 310ml Tẩy Da Chết Da Đầu Bồ Kết 200ml', along with 'GIẢM 36%' and prices '610K 389K', '423K 269K', '502K 319K'.
items: Top Left: Large combo copy block on a white background describing the refill shampoo and sugar shower gel bundle.
Top Right: Product pair of a green refill pouch and amber shower gel bottle, beside a white-outlined pink discount badge and a filled pink price circle.
Bottom Left: Combo of pomelo shampoo and pomelo hair tonic with another pink discount-price badge pair.
Bottom Right: Combo of Gleditsia scalp scrub and pomelo shampoo with repeated 'GIẢM 36%' and sale-price circle.
Center/Background: Spacious white layout organizing multiple bundles in a grid-like retail presentation.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even packshot illumination, faint grounding shadows, crisp price readability, clean e-commerce feel

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity retail catalog poster with realistic product packshots

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a multi-combo catalog of Cocoon hair and body care bundles. Centerpiece is a clean white retail layout with several product combos, including pomelo shampoo refill with sugar shower gel, pomelo shampoo with pomelo hair tonic, and pomelo shampoo with Gleditsia scalp scrub. Background is a plain white e-commerce field. Surrounding elements: combo text blocks, repeated 'GIẢM 36%' badges, and pink sale-price circles showing values like '610K 389K', '423K 269K', and '502K 319K'. Keep the neat grid structure, exact Vietnamese combo copy, and realistic packshot alignment. Technical style: high fidelity retail catalog poster with realistic product packshots, soft studio catalog lighting, even packshot illumination and crisp readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
